record.original_question: Let R = K[x1, ..., xm], let L1, ..., Lr be general linear forms in R, and let I = (x1^d, ..., xm^d, L1^d, ..., Lr^d). For which triples (m, d, r) does the Artinian algebra R/I fail the weak Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.12. Let R = K[x1, . . . , xm]. Let L1, . . . , Lr ∈ R be general linear forms, and let I = ⟨x^d_1, . . . , x^d_m, L^d_1, . . . , L^d_r⟩. Determine for which values of m, d and r the algebra R/I fails the WLP

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero and let $R = K[x_1, \ldots, x_m]$ be the polynomial ring in $m \ge 2$ variables. Fix integers $d \ge 2$ and $r \ge 1$, and let $L_1, \ldots, L_r \in R$ be general linear forms (i.e., the coefficient vectors lie in a non-empty Zariski-open subset of $K^{mr}$). Consider the ideal
$$I = (x_1^d, \ldots, x_m^d, L_1^d, \ldots, L_r^d) \subset R,$$
so that $A = R/I$ is a graded Artinian $K$-algebra. Recall that $A$ is said to have the Weak Lefschetz Property (WLP) if there exists a linear form $\ell \in R$ such that, for every integer $j \ge 0$, the multiplication map $\times \ell : A_j \to A_{j+1}$ has maximal rank (i.e., is either injective or surjective).

Determine all triples $(m, d, r)$ for which the Artinian algebra $A = R/I$ fails the Weak Lefschetz Property.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of classifying triples $(m,d,r)$ for which $R/I$ fails WLP, where $I$ is generated by $d$-th powers of the variables together with $d$-th powers of general linear forms, remains open in general. Only partial results are known: WLP holds in $K[x,y,z]$ (the case $m=3$) for any number of powers of general linear forms; for $d=2$ WLP fails at the $d$-th spot when $m<3d-2$; recent preprints (2024) give further partial results, e.g. for cubes when $m \ge (3d-3)/2$. A complete classification has not been established.

status_evidence.title: On the Weak Lefschetz Property for ideals generated by powers of general linear forms
status_evidence.snippet: WLP holds for the degree d spot when n≥3d−2 for squares, and n≥(3d−3)/2 for cubes; WLP fails for squares when n<3d−2 at the d-th spot.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results are known for specific values of d and ranges of m.

status_evidence.title: The Weak Lefschetz Property and powers of linear forms in K[x,y,z]
status_evidence.snippet: An Artinian quotient of K[x,y,z] by an ideal generated by powers of linear forms has the WLP.
status_evidence.claim: For m=3 the WLP always holds; higher m cases remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the weak Lefschetz property for almost complete intersections generated by uniform powers of general linear forms
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture and partial results that WLP fails for I=(L_0^d,...,L_{2n+1}^d) iff d>1, proved in specific ranges.
status_evidence.claim: Conjectural classification for almost complete intersection case with only partial proofs.
